prompts.prompt: Create a polished full-page desktop website design mockup, 1024 x 1536 portrait, for a premium Korean industrial automation company named HANGYEOL. This is UI-MOCKUP work, not an illustration. Direction: HUMAN ENGINEERING. Make the company feel like a modern engineering partner, not an old factory supplier. Use a white header and an asymmetric hero: a large editorial photograph of a Korean engineer in a bright, clean automated facility occupies the left side, while bold Korean typography occupies the right white field. The image should show real machinery and human expertise without stock-photo posing. Headline: 현장을 이해하는 자동화. Supporting line: 설계부터 설치, 운영까지 하나의 팀으로. Use one vivid vermilion-orange accent for the primary button, tiny labels, and fine rules. Buttons may be solid, outline, or text-link according to hierarchy. After the hero, create a spacious white page with a large project story section, one wide real installation photograph, a simple numbered engineering process, then a compact product family index with varied widths rather than three equal cards. Finish with a restrained contact call to action on white. Navigation: 회사소개, 제품, 산업솔루션, 프로젝트, 기술지원. Primary action: 프로젝트 상담. Modern 2026 Korean B2B design: strong Swiss editorial grid, generous whitespace, crisp contemporary sans-serif typography, large numbers, disciplined alignment, premium real photography. All non-photo surfaces must be pure white. Do not use gray, beige, navy, blue, or colored section backgrounds. Do not make a dashboard, generic SaaS cards, rounded pill overload, decorative gradients, glassmorphism, or an old corporate template. Do not reuse these previous arrangements: text-left/product-photo-right hero, headline-above-panorama hero, isolated conveyor product stage, or a generic three-card row. Make it realistic to implement with React, Tailwind CSS grid/flex, ordinary CSS, and small Lucide-style interface icons.

Create a polished full-page desktop website design mockup, 1024 x 1536 portrait, for a premium Korean industrial automation company named HANGYEOL. This is UI-MOCKUP work. Direction: MONUMENTAL PRECISION. Build the visual identity around a cinematic macro photograph of polished conveyor rollers, bearings, sensors, and machined aluminum. Start with a thin white header. Below it, use one edge-to-edge macro industrial photograph as the dominant hero plane. Place a short Korean headline in a clean white margin that intersects the photo edge without becoming a card: 정밀함이 생산성을 만듭니다. Add a cobalt-blue primary action 제품 살펴보기 and a quiet text link 기술 상담. Use oversized typographic product codes and hairline measurement marks as a refined catalog language, but do not imitate a blueprint. Below, keep every non-photo surface pure white. Present one flagship system as a large horizontal editorial feature with the product name HX-400 모듈러 컨베이어, a close product crop, three short specifications, and a clear inquiry action. Follow with an offset two-row product index using large names and partial image crops instead of equal cards. Include one black-and-white case study photograph, a minimal client proof line, and a final white contact area. The result should feel like a contemporary architecture or automotive brand adapted to industrial equipment: tactile materials, severe grid, restrained cobalt accent, confident typography, generous negative space. Use sharp or subtly rounded geometry only where functional. No colored section backgrounds, tinted bands, gradients, glassmorphism, bento dashboard, icon clusters, or generic three-card product grids. Do not reuse previous split text-left/conveyor-right heroes, panorama-with-title-above compositions, or isolated conveyor-on-white product stages. Make it feasible with React, Tailwind CSS, normal CSS layout, SVG rules, and Lucide-style arrows.

Create a polished full-page desktop website design mockup, 1024 x 1536 portrait, for a premium Korean industrial automation company named HANGYEOL. UI-MOCKUP. Direction: KINETIC OVERVIEW. The opening must be genuinely different from a split hero or headline-above-panorama. Use a white navigation header, then one tall full-width cinematic photograph of an advanced automated production line viewed from an elevated diagonal angle. Integrate the Korean headline directly inside the photograph in a calm dark area: 흐름을 바꾸는 자동화. Make the type large and architectural, with one compact black call-to-action 솔루션 보기. A thin acid-lime route line crosses part of the image and ends in a small numbered marker, as if tracing material movement. Do not put the headline in a separate white area above or beside the image. Below the photo, everything is pure white. Create one very simple horizontal process statement with three huge words and numbers: 01 진단 / 02 설계 / 03 구축, separated only by thin vertical rules, not cards. Then a single large case-study composition with a wide installation photograph on the left and big evidence numbers on the right. Next, show products as a strict text-led index with small cutout product images aligned on one baseline. Finish with a spacious contact statement and one action. Keep the page quieter than a typical industrial homepage. Current high-end engineering consultancy aesthetic, confident Korean sans-serif typography, severe grid, generous whitespace, realistic industrial photography, clear information hierarchy. All non-photo surfaces pure white. Acid lime only for tiny markers and line accents; black controls are allowed. No colored section backgrounds, gradients, glassmorphism, rounded card sets, dashboard UI, bento grid, decorative blobs, generic three-card row, text-left/product-right hero, title-above-panorama hero, or isolated conveyor on white. Realistically implementable with React, Tailwind CSS, normal CSS positioning, SVG lines, and minimal Lucide-style arrows.
